outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with mean±SD bars, and individual data points (dots/squares) are clearly overlaid for each mouse.
Panel B shows gross photographic images of mice, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C consists of H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a quantitative plot.
Panel D is a dot blot and methylene blue staining image (blot type), not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification bar chart shows individual data points (dots) for both NC and HFD groups alongside the mean bars.
The top part of panel F is a western blot (not a plot), but the bottom bar graph quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH displays individual data points (dots/squares) overlaid on the bars.
